responsibility: Declares shared utility types and helper APIs used across GCC IPA passes. It exposes SCC/DFS bookkeeping structures, callgraph order and cycle helpers, profile and recursion utilities, CFG termination and always-executed-block queries, pure/const/profile/devirt-related cross-file interfaces, and numerous polymorphic-call/type-ODR helper declarations. It is the umbrella utility header tying together common IPA support functionality.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the declaration umbrella for shared IPA utility types and helper interfaces—including ipa_dfs_info and many cross-pass APIs—while ipa-utils.cc supplies the core callgraph/CFG utility implementations.
